git commit -m "feat(transport): answer list_sessions off the per-session lock

Threads sessionStore into createMessageHandler and answers list_sessions
beside ping, from the connection's own user: summaries serialised to ISO
strings, an empty list without listFor, SERVER_ERROR under a ws-category
log when listFor fails. Adds SessionSummaryFrame and SessionListMessage
to the protocol types and exports them.

Also clears the last push's red build: the validator dispatches through
a lookup table with the limit rule lifted into a named predicate, the
validation test asserts one object, and the socket suites share their
teardown, drain wait and delegating store through wsTestSupport.
CHANGELOG carries the frames under Unreleased.

Ref: re-cinq/HALEngine#144
